record.field: Thailand monthly payroll: Social Security Fund (employee & employer, wage-capped) and personal income tax via the annualised progressive schedule with the standard 50% expense deduction (capped) and personal allowance. SSF/PIT rates come from the Thailand legislation pack. Only the personal + expense allowances are modelled — other PIT allowances are a v1 limitation.
